posts.title_en: Wow, a raid gear preset is a whole new world
posts.summary_en: Author built a gear preset picking only 스증/스가/피감 and says raid score jumped. A long comment thread lays out a four-preset system: raid (스증치피, 스증스가, 피감체력, 스가피감), arena (스증치확, 스증스가, 피감치저, 스가피감), stage 55% 'raw power' preset and stage 35% 'solid power' preset with 명중/집중. Explains why crit dmg beats crit rate in raid: monsters have no crit resistance and buffs push crit rate very high.

gear.slot: all four (장비창 기준: 좌상단, 우상단, 좌하단, 우하단)
gear.context: raid end-game ('종결세팅' via comment on arena/raid)
gear.why: 명중/집중 are useless in raid; crit res irrelevant vs monsters
enemy players carry 치저; effective crit = my 치확 − enemy 치저

gear.substats: weapons only roll 스증 as the key line; raid 스증치피, arena 스증치확
gear.why: 스증/스가 are first priority on every item

gear.substats: 좌상단 스증 + 치피 or 명중; 우상단 스증스가 or 명중집중 item; bottom 피감체력, 스가피감
gear.why: Max stage 328 needs 명중 1200; 900–1000 ultimately enough; check Crumble Hub 명중 cut

mechanics: Crit rate above 100% (e.g. 200%) = crit twice per hit, per commenter; in arena effective crit = own 치확 − enemy 치저.
In stage/raid monsters have no crit res and buffs raise crit rate a lot, so 치피 is taken to exploit it.
disagreements: Author asked whether raid preset (스증스가피감) can double as arena; commenter says make a separate arena preset (weapon 스증치확, bottom-left 치저피감).

quotes.kr: 장비창 화면 기준으로 스증치피, 스증스가 피감치저, 스가피감 이렇게 맞추면 종결세팅임
quotes.en: By gear-screen layout: amp+crit dmg, amp+haste, DR+crit res, haste+DR is the end-game setup

quotes.kr: 스테 토벌에서는 어차피 몬스터는 치저도 없고 버프로 치확 존나 높아져서 치확딜 효율 증가 시켜주는 치피를 챙기는거임
quotes.en: In stage/raid monsters have no crit res and buffs push crit rate way up, so you take crit dmg to boost crit-damage efficiency

quotes.kr: 모든 장비에서 스증, 스가 애네가 무조건 1순위 옵션이라고 보면 되고 어차피 무기는 스증만 나옴 토벌은 스증치피, 아레나는 스증치확 챙기면 됨

posts.title_en: Raid Cherry deck 700x
posts.summary_en: 1T 312G at 1.8G team power = 728배 with a Cherry deck in which 석류/피노/정전/닼초/체리 are Lv.1 and 전갈 Lv.10, no move speed. Author explains the logic: Lv.1 cookies minimise the chance that cookies who shouldn't get Pomegranate's straw grab Milk's ATK buff first and scramble the ATK order; Pomegranate at Lv.1 because her level doesn't change the buff and it lowers power, which inflates the multiple ('배수딸'). ATK order 우유 > 브시 > 피겨 > 카롱 > 실론 > 치케, 전갈 at least 10% below 6th because the Wasabi pet adds 8% ATK on entry. Best run is lucky; average 600–800배, and a guildmate with the same deck gets ~200배.

5 support/filler cookies at Lv.1 so they never outrank the carries in ATK and steal Pomegranate's straw
전갈 deliberately given Lv.10 so a stray straw lands on Scorpion (has skill-amp use) instead of Dark Choco
